svg.title: IEC 62443 zones and conduits of the factory, DMZ, target security levels and firewall rules
svg.text: IEC 62443 – zones (dashed), conduits (firewalls) and rules of the factory – deny everything that is not listed
time server .100 · B2MML gateway .101 · historian mirror .102 · patch server .103 · jump host (MFA, recording)
every flow ENDS here and a new one starts – nothing passes through
PROFINET RT stays inside each cell (not routed)
PROFIsafe inside the cells · no routing, no conduit
C3 to cells · C4 to AGV zone
Conduit rules (11.7, 31.3) – stateful, log every deny
Never allowed: Enterprise → cells · Internet → any OT zone ·
cloud → machines (data goes out only, via the DMZ).
SL-T = target security level (proposal – confirm in the
risk assessment IEC 62443-3-2). SL 1 mistakes · SL 2 simple
intentional attack · SL 3 sophisticated · SL 4 extended resources.
Conduits: C0 internet edge · C1 IT ↔ DMZ · C2 DMZ ↔ OT (operations, supervisory) · C3 L3/L2 ↔ cells · C4 AGV zone · C6 vendor VPN → jump host
Back-to-back DMZ (two firewalls, ideally two makers) – HA pairs. Remote access only: VPN → jump host (MFA, personal account, time limit, recording) → target.
IEC 62443 zones, conduits and firewall rules
